title: Denzel Washington reveals his favorite breakfast at 71
seoTitle: Denzel Washington Reveals Favorite Breakfast at 71
subtitle: The actor shared details of his morning routine during a Reddit AMA
excerpt: Answering questions on Reddit, Denzel Washington, 71, described his typical breakfast – eggs, bacon, hash browns, orange juice, and coffee – and revealed.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Denzel Washington, at 71, drew attention once again by sharing his favorite breakfast during a Reddit AMA. His response brought to light details of the actor's diet and recent changes in his lifestyle habits.

What makes up Denzel Washington's breakfast

During the Q&A session, Washington described a simple and classic American staple: eggs, bacon, hash browns, orange juice, and a cup of coffee. He emphasized his preference for a small restaurant where the combination is served in a traditional way.

Varieties and treat options

Beyond the basic combination, the actor mentioned that he also enjoys omelets as one of his favorite choices. On special occasions, he cited French toast as a sweet treat he includes in his morning meal.

Changes to his dietary routine

In an interview with Esquire published in November 2024, Washington revealed that, starting in February 2023, he began working out with a personal trainer recommended by Lenny Kravitz. The trainer not only guides his workouts but also prepares his meals, contributing to a diet more focused on well-being.

Decision to quit alcohol

The actor also shared that he stopped drinking at age 60. He pointed out that, reaching December 2024, he will complete ten years without consuming alcohol, a decision that is part of a broader effort toward self-care and health.

Impact of changing habits

Washington stated that, over the decades, he adapted his routine to different stages of life, moving from more stable habits to a diet that prioritizes balance and the energy needed to keep his Hollywood career active.

With information from O GLOBO, TNH1, AOL.com.
